description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, providing improved performance, security patches, and access to modern language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded Java from 21 to 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images (build and runtime stages). Build succeeded with JDK Temurin 25.0.3, all 22 source files compiled cleanly, and all unit tests passed.
